title: Bob Run
description:
Bob Run is a retro-inspired platformer where speed is your greatest ally.

Guide Bob through a series of challenging levels, collecting useful items and reaching the exit before time runs out.

                                                         Each stage gives you only 10 seconds to escape. 

                              Stay too long, and a deadly meteor shower will turn your adventure into chaos.

Run, jump, explore, and react quickly as new obstacles and hazards stand in your way.

       As Bob travels beyond Earth aboard his spaceship, he begins to uncover the mystery behind the falling meteors.

Features:

• Run through more than 40 handcrafted levels
• Fast-paced platforming gameplay
• Retro-style pixel art graphics
• Collectible items and secrets
• Simple controls and accessible gameplay

 

Run Bob. RUN!
description_short: Bob Run is a charming retro-style platformer about speed and survival.  Race through levels, collect useful items, and reach the exit before time runs out. If you're too slow, meteors will start raining from the sky!  Easy to learn, fun to master, and packed with retro charm.
